payload.description:
**Found after b3e12c live deploy of #147.**

Worker credential recycle is green: `stale_waiting=409`. The rest of `python/scripts/live_aws_thin_turn.sh development` then exits 1:

```
first_stream_kinds=['turn.started', 'turn.failed'] dropped_mid_stream=False
reconnect_last_event_id=1
resumed_stream_kinds=['turn.failed']
duplicate seqs across drop/reconnect: [1, 2, 2]
```

Lambda URL development ThinTurn. Computers desiredCount 0. Never `--all`.

**Do:** determine whether the greeting turn is failing for a real worker/LLM reason or the reconnect gate is mis-asserting when the first stream never dropped mid-token. One path. Gherkin if it is product.

**Done when:** `cd python && sh scripts/live_aws_thin_turn.sh development` exits 0 against development after a named ChatticusThinTurn deploy.
payload.title: Live thin-turn reconnect reports duplicate seqs after turn.failed
